about.title: About
about.subtitle: The Human Behind the Code
about.pullQuote: “I engineer systems designed to survive reality — and build communities designed to leave no one behind.”
about.description1: Most code breaks when reality hits. As a Senior Tech Lead based in El Salvador, I take ownership of the hardest architectural challenges—turning complex problems into clean, scalable systems that actually ship.
about.description2: But tech is only half the equation. Our industry's biggest bottleneck isn't bandwidth—it's access. That's why I spend my time off the clock building communities to help more women across Central America break into tech.
about.description3: When I'm not architecting systems or organizing events, you'll probably find me hunting for the best ramen in town, staying active, or losing track of time in Animal Crossing and Pokémon.
